DECISION AND DIRECTION OF ELECTION
Pursuant to Section 12 of the Public Employment Relations Act (PERA), 1965 PA 379, as
amended, MCL 423.212, MSA 17.455(12), this case was heard at Lansing, Michigan on June
17,1997, before Julia C. Stern, Administrative Law Judge for the Michigan Employment Relations
Commission. Pursuant to Section 13 and 14 of PERA, and based on the record received on July 9,
1998, including the stipulation of the parties, the Commssion finds as follows:
The Petition,Positions of the Parties, and Stipulation as to Unit:
This petition was filed on April 28, 1998 by the Nurses for Nurses Association. Petitioner
seeks to represent an existing bargaining unit of registered nurses currently represented by the
Incumbent Service Employees International Union, Local 79, AFL-CIO. At the hearing the
Incumbent indicated that it objected to an election being conducted in this case because it had
information that Petitioner had obtained its showing of interest through fraud and misrepresentation.
Incumbent was informed that this issue could not be litigated in the context of a representation case.
Incumbent was informed that if it wished to raise this issue it should file an unfair labor practice

charge.
No other issues were raised at the hearing. The parties stipulated at the hearing to the unit
description as set forth below.
Order Directing Election
We find that a question concerning representation exists under Section 12 of PERA, and we
direct an election in the following unit which we find, pursuant to the parties’ stipulation, to be
appropriate for purposes of collective bargaining:
All full-time and regular part-time registered nurses, including graduate and Baylor
nurses, employed by the West Shore Hospital and included in the bargaining unit
currently represented by the Service Employees International Union, Local 79, AFL-
CIO; but excluding the director of nurses, supervisory nurses, utilization review
nurses, patient education coordinator, in-service coordinator, and all other employees.
Pursuant to the attached Direction of Election, the above employees shall vote whether they wish to
be represented by the Nurses for Nurses Association, by the Service Employees International Union,
Local 79, AFL-CIO, or by neither labor organization.
MICHIGAN EMPLOYMENT RELATIONS COMMISSION
